<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1004
Claimant:
Jeffrey Burton
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2024-07-18
Claim received for a collision at an intersection where the insured was turning left and was struck by an oncoming
vehicle. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by an attorney.
2024-08-12
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision and records the other
driver's account. The driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force on the date of loss.
2024-08-13
Spoke with the claimant, who described the left turn, the oncoming car, and the impact to the driver's side front. The
account matched what was given at the scene.
2024-08-24
Two independent witnesses were contacted and both confirm the accident happened as the claimant described it.
The other driver also gave a consistent version by phone.
2024-09-20
Photos from the scene and the repair estimate show damage consistent with the reported impact. No prior damgae to
the vehicle is recorded in our files or in the inspection notes.
2024-09-21
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The vehicle inspection found no signs of
earlier repairs in the affected areas.
2024-09-24
Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder after the crash and was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day. The
injury pattern appears consistent with the force and direction of the collision.
2024-11-01
Treatment records show a usual course of physical therapy and follow-up visits. Reported pain has eased steadily as
the claimant improved, and the provider notes a tapering of care.
2024-11-25
Medical history reviewed. The claimant had a minor strain in the same shoulder several years ago that resolved fully
with care and has not been treated since.
2024-12-27
Claimant repeated the same account of the collision in each contact with our office. Based on the evidence reviewed,
the injury and vehicle damage fit the reported loss, and the file is ready for the next settlement review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
